messages:
Sarah (Support): FYI incoming escalation from AcmeTravel — their requests that use function-calling to invoke the 'search_flights' tool are failing with a JSON schema validation error. They pasted the SDK response: 

Error: schema validation failed: required property 'departure_date' missing; additionalProperties 'debug_mode' not allowed; instance.max_results: expected integer but got string

Can someone take a look? Customer is blocked in prod, high priority. :rotating_light:

Mike (Eng Runtime): can you paste the original function_call payload they sent (redact PII)? also which SDK + runtime versions?

Sarah (Support): they sent this (redacted) from SDK 1.2.0, runtime v2026-03-10: 

```json
{
  "tool": "search_flights",
  "args": {
    "origin": "SFO",
    "destination": "LAX",
    "departure_date": null,
    "max_results": "5",
    "debug_mode": true,
    "notes": "please prioritize cheap fares"
  }
}
```

Sarah (Support): server response: 

```
{
  "error": "SchemaValidationError",
  "details": [
    "required property 'departure_date' missing",
    "instance.max_results: expected integer but got string",
    "additionalProperties ["debug_mode", "notes"] not allowed"
  ]
}
```

Kevin (DevEx): that payload has three issues: departure_date is null/missing, max_results is the wrong type, and we changed the tool schema to forbid additionalProperties. Did the customer previously rely on permissive schemas?

Mike (Eng Runtime): yes — earlier we had additionalProperties: true for most tools. On 2026-03-10 we merged an enforcement change to the schema registry to flip additionalProperties=false for safety. The change was intended, but I thought we had updated the SDK to validate/transform before calling. Looks like SDK 1.2.0 didn't include the new coercion.

Laura (Infra Oncall): deploy-bot shows a config rollout at 2026-03-10 14:22 UTC that toggled strict validation for tool schemas in the control plane. We can temporarily toggle back to permissive to let customers through while we patch the SDK/docs.

Mike (Eng Runtime): workaround for the customer: ensure departure_date is an ISO date string, send max_results as an integer, and remove debug_mode/notes. I'll add a server-side guard to return a more helpful validation error now (short term).

Sarah (Support): I need explicit repro steps to pass to the customer. Can you provide a corrected request example we can paste? Also ETA on rollback or patch?

Mike (Eng Runtime): corrected example:

```json
{
  "tool": "search_flights",
  "args": {
    "origin": "SFO",
    "destination": "LAX",
    "departure_date": "2026-04-02",
    "max_results": 5
  }
}
```

Mike (Eng Runtime): ETA: immediate temporary rollback of strict schema enforcement (10–15m) if Infra approves. Patch to SDK and a runtime change to coerce simple types + clearer errors will go out in the next patch window (SDK 1.2.1 + runtime v2026-03-11).

Laura (Infra Oncall): rolling back control-plane flag now. deploy-bot: please run toggle command.

deploy-bot: starting rollout to control-plane flags (toggle: tool_schema_strict_validation=false) ...

deploy-bot: rollout complete — flag set to false across regions (all checks green)

Kevin (DevEx): I'll draft a short support doc/snippet for function-calling schema errors and add it to the SDK release notes. Also will add an SDK client-side validator that warns about missing required fields and coerces numbers when safe.

Sarah (Support): I told AcmeTravel the temporary rollback is done and provided the corrected request example. They were able to proceed after changing max_results to integer. They're still a bit worried about future breakage; can we get a firm plan and timeline so I can escalate to their SRE?

Mike (Eng Runtime): plan: 1) short-term rollback (done); 2) SDK 1.2.1 release with client-side validation & type coercion (ETA: 48h); 3) server-side schema enforcement re-introduced behind a staged rollout + better error messages (ETA: 1 week); 4) update tool registry docs to specify required fields and allowed properties (ETA: 72h). I'll open the runtime PR and link it here.

Mike (Eng Runtime): PR: https://internal.redwood/eng/runtime/pull/3842

Sarah (Support): thanks. I created support ticket RED-12452 and updated the customer with the plan and timelines. I'll follow up once they confirm the SDK patch. :white_check_mark:

Kevin (DevEx): postmortem notes: we should add an integration test where SDK sample payloads are validated against the canonical tool schema on CI. I'll own that.

Laura (Infra Oncall): monitoring: added an alert for schema-validation failures on /tool-invoke endpoints (threshold: >5 errors/min).

Sarah (Support): closing this thread for now — will reopen if customer sees more failures. Kudos to the team for the quick rollback. :tada:
